title: The Wizard of the Ripples
notes: Recurring detective-cast (young Shinichi/Conan, Ran, Yukiko, Yusaku) omitted by convention even though this episode's flashback frame stars a child-age Shinichi as the on-scene solver -- he is the same fixed detective persona used throughout the dataset. Old cases/ep881-882 file's culprit identification (the sandal-buying woman, Kitamori Yasue) is confirmed correct by the transcript -- no discrepancy there. Corrections/additions vs. the old file: (1) the old file spelled the third suspect's surname 'Ooami'; the transcript's on-screen name card reads 'Oami Raiya', corrected here; (2) the old file's suspect pool and 2 objects/clues covered only the theft-of-the-day; this rebuild adds the getaway driver (dies in the crash, never named on-screen), Fukumizu's unnamed girlfriend (whose shove into the ocean is the innocent explanation for his wet clothes), and the framing-story family (Shuichi Akai, Mary Sera, Shukichi Haneda, young Masumi Sera, and their father Tsutomu, referred to by first name only) since they are named, plot-relevant figures in the episode even though they aren't suspects in the theft. case_type: theft (the driver's death is an accidental crash, not a killing by any suspect, matching the old file's theft classification).

clues.desc: Fukumizu's watch read 1:45 and Oami's two watches both read 2:00, all plausible running times, but Kitamori's watch was stuck at 10:10 -- the default display time new store watches are set to, proving hers was stolen stock, not a running watch.
Fukumizu and Oami paid normally for their beach-hut purchases, but Kitamori could only pay in coins for cheap sandals -- her banknotes had been soaked in the ocean and were too suspicious to spend.
The sunken car's passenger-side window was open while the unbelted driver died on impact -- proving a second occupant opened it underwater to escape after finding him unresponsive.

edges.detail: car broke through the guardrail; driver wasn't wearing a seatbelt and broke his neck on impact

pushed him off a rubber boat into the ocean after he rejected her marriage proposal, soaking his clothes
drove off alone, leaving Fukumizu stranded and soaked
